It feels like my body has completely adapted
to the training regimens you design for me.
Yes!

Ufufu♪ I've been feeling in top shape lately.
I've already hit today's quota, but I feel like I could keep going.
Suddenly, I realized I was still holding Super Creek's hand.

A quiet moment passes between us...
After a few waves roll in and out, she speaks up.

Trainer. Do you remember?
A while ago, you asked me if there was anything I wanted you to do for me.
Ehe... Trainer.
I'm looking forward to being with you, forever and ever.

Yes, absolutely.
The training camp is still going on, after all.
During summer training camp――

I hurriedly reached into my pocket for a handkerchief.
Just then――

My, the crowd has really gotten huge, hasn't it?
We should be careful not to get separated...

You have such a serious look on your face...
even though you have takoyaki sauce right next to your mouth.

Yes, truly. Ever since the day we met,
you've grown into such a wonderful person... and that makes me so very happy.
I went around the festival stalls with Super Creek and bought some food...
Fufu, was that so?

Still, because we held hands so tightly, we didn't get separated.
Fufu...♪

Bathed in Super Creek's gentle gaze,
a strong urge to live up to her trust wells up within me.

Back there, Trainer...
you looked so very dependable.
We've been practicing non-stop, so you must be starving, right?

Ufufu, there are so many children here.
Seeing them all having so much fun is truly wonderful.

Truth be told... I was actually about to say the exact same thing.
But you beat me to it.

Going forward, you'll gain plenty of experience
and grow into an even more remarkable trainer.

Let's buy some food and find a scenic spot
to enjoy it together at our own pace♪

T-Trainer...!
With me...!
As night fell, the summer festival grounds grew even livelier.

――No sooner had I said that than a huge crowd surged through,
sweeping Super Creek away in the opposite direction!

It's because you made this menu with my needs in mind, Trainer,
so I suppose that's only natural.

Well then, shall we look around?
...My, there are so many stalls, I can't decide where to look first.

Even when you become a truly accomplished trainer...
will you still let me pamper you forever?

Accepting Super Creek's invitation,
we headed over to the summer festival grounds.

I just thought of something.
Will you hear me out?

Seeing what a good trainer you've been,
it makes me want to give you a special reward♪
*pant*... *pant*... *pant*... *pant*...!

Without giving me a chance to object,
Super Creek gently wiped the sauce from the corner of my mouth.
...There, all clean.

Yes♪ It looks like there's a summer festival happening nearby.
Would you like to go check it out together?

We should be fine now that we've made it here.
Fufu, that was quite an ordeal, wasn't it?

Holding tightly onto Super Creek's hand,
I managed to push our way out through the crowd.
Um... about you asking to 'hold hands.'
Stop. Wait up.

Fufu, it's nothing.
Today's training was truly fulfilling as well.
Oh? Oh my goodness~?

Trainer... um...
Fufufu.

...Now then, let's save the talk for later and eat before it gets cold.
The takoyaki will lose its warmth, after all.

Fufu, there's no need to fluster yourself so much.
After all, you were the one who suggested holding hands in the first place, Trainer.
Phew... How was that, Trainer?

Super Creek has been in excellent condition lately.
At this rate, we should be able to produce great results once the camp concludes.
Gazing out at the night sea, I ate the takoyaki together with Super Creek.
――About what you said earlier...
I quickly let go of her hand...

...Oh my, look at the time.
I got so focused that I lost track of it completely~.
